content: Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) is particularly advantageous for individuals with diabetes who are at an elevated risk of experiencing hypoglycemia or hyperglycemia, especially those who require insulin therapy. CGM delivers real-time information regarding glucose fluctuations, enabling both patients and healthcare professionals to make more precise and informed decisions regarding diabetes management strategies. Metrics provided by CGM, such as time in range (TIR), time spent above the target glucose range, and time spent below the target range, are critical tools for assessing glycemic control. These metrics facilitate the optimization of treatment plans to achieve improved blood glucose outcomes.
